seed.narrative: Eisley Hiro a reward for her help. She is very happy and excited to receive it.
seed.literal: Eisley offers Hiro a reward. Now Eisley feels rewarded.

turns.speaker: Eisley
turns.text: Hiro, you asked me to come by—did the museum board decide what to do about the archive?

turns.speaker: Hiro
turns.text: They did. Your notes led us to the sealed room before the renovation crew touched it, and the board wants to thank you properly.

turns.speaker: Eisley
turns.text: [burst of delighted laughter] Thank me? I just followed the old floor plans and hoped I wasn't sending everyone into a broom closet.

turns.speaker: Hiro
turns.text: [wide yawn] You found a collection everyone thought was gone. This is a cash award, and there is a letter offering you a research fellowship.

turns.speaker: Eisley
turns.text: [sigh of relief] This covers my tuition gap for the semester. I was trying not to panic about that.

turns.speaker: Hiro
turns.text: [long yawn] I am glad it reached you in time. The board also asked whether you would catalog the collection with us this summer.

turns.speaker: Eisley
turns.text: [trembling sigh] My grandfather used to bring me here and tell me every locked door had a story behind it. He would have loved this.

turns.speaker: Hiro
turns.text: [warm laughter] Then you already had the right training. We would be lucky to have you on the project.

turns.speaker: Eisley
turns.text: [shaky sob] I keep thinking I need to wake up before someone takes the letter back. Yes—yes, I want to do it.

turns.speaker: Hiro
turns.text: [weary sigh] No one is taking it back. I argued for you because I watched you do the work when everyone else had given up.

turns.speaker: Eisley
turns.text: [relieved sob] Thank you for seeing me, Hiro. I am going to make this collection worthy of all the people who protected it.

turns.speaker: Hiro
turns.text: [sleepy yawn] Start by celebrating tonight. Tomorrow, after I have slept, we can plan your first day.

vocalizations.intention_after: Express amazed happiness before modestly explaining her role.
Push through his exhaustion and reveal the full reward.
Explain why the money changes her immediate situation.
Move from the award to the summer job offer.
Share the personal meaning behind her excitement.
Affirm her belonging on the project.
Accept the offer despite feeling overwhelmed.
Reassure her that the recognition is secure.
Thank him and promise to honor the opportunity.
Postpone planning while encouraging her to celebrate.
